task: Place the MEDICINE_BOTTLE on MEDICAL_TABLE after removing the obstacle in front of the CAR.
plan_summary: The robot will first navigate to the MEDICINE_BOTTLE (obstacle in front of CAR), pick it up, then navigate to the MEDICAL_TABLE, and place the MEDICINE_BOTTLE on it.
assumptions: The MEDICINE_BOTTLE is graspable by the robot.
The MEDICINE_BOTTLE is within interaction distance after navigation.
The MEDICAL_TABLE is within interaction distance after navigation.
